photoSkips.name: Cinema 6
photoSkips.why: reviewed: Commons match shows the Ocean Bank headquarters, not the cinema

photoSkips.name: The Fillmore Miami Beach at the Jackie Gleason Theater
photoSkips.why: reviewed: Commons match is a dedication plaque, not the venue

sample.name: Rooftop Cinema Club South Beach
facts: Open-air cinema on a 6th-floor terrace at the western end of the Lincoln Road promenade
Guests hear the film through wireless headphones
Was announced in 2022 as South Beach's first rooftop movie theater

sample.name: Knight Center for Music Innovation
facts: The 25,000-square-foot hub is part of UM's Frost School of Music.
It is named for a gift from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation.
It houses the 200-seat Robert and Judi Prokop Newman Recital Hall.

sample.name: AMC Sunset Place 24
facts: The theater offers IMAX at AMC and Dolby Cinema at AMC screens.
It has reserved seating and a MacGuffins Bar.
Has 24 screens

sample.name: James L. Knight Center Theater
facts: The theater has flexible seating for up to 4,569 people.
The Knight Center complex opened in 1982 and is named after newspaper publisher James L. Knight.
The complex hosts Miami Dade College graduation ceremonies each year.

sample.name: Teatro Trail
facts: Built in 1930 as the Trail Theater
Bought by Marco Gómez in 1963 and showed Spanish-language movies in the 1960s and 1970s
Comedian Armando Roblán staged his political satires here in the 1980s and 1990s

sample.name: FPL Solar Amphitheater at Bayfront Park
facts: A solar canopy of 500 panels and seven solar trees generates about 250 kilowatts.
The installation tests bifacial solar panels, which produce energy on both sides.
FPL built it with the Bayfront Park Management Trust, the City of Miami and Live Nation.

sample.name: Silverspot Cinema
facts: Has 17 screens
Address: 300 Southeast 3rd Street, Unit 100, Miami

sample.name: Ashe Auditorium
facts: The auditorium is part of the James L. Knight Center in downtown Miami.

sample.name: The Fillmore Miami Beach at the Jackie Gleason Theater
facts: Became The Fillmore Miami Beach, operated by Live Nation, after a 2007 makeover
Founded in 1951
Designed by Russell T. Pancoast and Henry Hohauser

sample.name: Colony Theatre / Miami New Drama
facts: Paramount Pictures opened it in 1935 as an Art Deco movie house seating 1,200.
Address: 1040 Lincoln Road, Miami Beach

sample.name: Jerry Herman Ring Theatre
facts: Robert M. Little and Marion M. Manley designed the circular building, built from 1951 to 1953.
It honors Jerry Herman, a 1953 UM alumnus who composed Hello, Dolly! and Mame.
It serves as the student theatre of the University of Miami.

sample.name: Cinema 6
facts: Known as Le Jeune Cinemas 6, the sixplex is run by independent operator Ocean Cinemas.
Its six screens have 899 seats in total.

sample.name: Gusman Concert Hall
facts: The Frost School of Music hall seats 600 and is used for recitals, concerts and recordings.
Run by University of Miami
Official name: Maurice Gusman Music Hall

sample.name: Victor E. Clarke Recital Hall
facts: Recital hall of the University of Miami Frost School of Music in the L. Austin Weeks Center
Designed by acoustician Charles Bonner, with draperies that adjust the acoustics
Named for Victor E. Clarke, a UM trustee and philanthropist

sample.name: Landmark at Merrick Park
facts: It opened on December 16, 2016 in a former Borders Books space next to Neiman Marcus.
It has laser projection, Dolby 7.1 sound and reserved recliners.
Its auditoriums range from a 25-seat screening room to 150 seats.

sample.name: Manuel Artime Theater
facts: The building was formerly the Riverside Baptist Church.
The City of Miami bought the property in 1975.
It was renamed in 1982 for Dr. Manuel Artime Buesa, a leader of Cuban Brigade 2506.

sample.name: Thriller Miami Speedboat Adventures
facts: Has offered speedboat tours in Miami since 2006
Fleet includes three Thriller vessels and one Thriller Miami Hurricane
Address: 401 Biscayne Boulevard, Miami

sample.name: Cosford Cinema
facts: The building went up in 1947 as the Beaumont Lecture Hall and became the Beaumont Cinema in the 1950s.
It was renamed in 1994 for Bill Cosford, Miami Herald film critic and UM cinema professor.
The single-screen art house shows both 35mm and high definition digital formats.

sample.name: Cinépolis Luxury Cinemas
facts: The 648-seat theater at the CocoWalk center first opened in February 2015.
The building covers 51,371 square feet.
Auditoriums have fully reclining leather seats and in-theater waiter service.

sample.name: O Cinema South Beach
facts: Has 1 screen
Address: 1130 Washington Avenue, Miami Beach

sample.name: CMX
facts: This CMX dine-in cinema at Brickell City Centre has plush leather recliners and Dolby Atmos sound.
Has 10 screens
Address: 701 South Miami Avenue, Miami
